mapper.select: select user_id from t_user where user_id = #{adminUserId} and coalesce(status, 0) = 0 for update
select urm.id from t_user_role_map urm inner join t_role r on r.role_id = urm.role_id where urm.user_id = #{adminUserId} and upper(r.name) = 'ORG_ADMIN' order by urm.id limit 1 for update

select assignment.id from t_copywriting_organization_admin_assignment assignment inner join t_copywriting copywriting on copywriting.user_id = assignment.account_user_id where copywriting.copywriting_id = #{copywritingId} and assignment.admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} limit 1 for update
